description: Updates an existing post in an esa team by post number. You can update the title, content, tags, category, and WIP status. To ship a post (mark as complete), set wip to false - this is preferred over using esa_ship_post when updating other fields simultaneously. To only add content to the start or end of the body, use esa_append_post or esa_prepend_post instead.

bodyMd.description: The post content in Markdown format. Use 4 spaces for indentation.

originalRevision.description: Original revision to check for conflicts

teamName.description: Team name (required). Use esa_get_teams first to see available teams.

wip.description: Whether the post is Work In Progress. Set to false to ship it (mark as complete and ready to be published)

name: esa_update_post
title: Update an existing esa post
